name: Currency API
description: Fetches currency exchange rates from CurrencyAPI.com on cron and displays them with optional per-currency buy/sell markup.
project_description: Currency API integrates a Drupal 10.2+/11 site with the CurrencyAPI.com REST service. A cron job fetches the latest exchange rates for a configured, comma-separated list of currency codes and stores them in the expirable key/value store. A service (currencyapi.service) exposes helpers to read all rates, convert an amount between currencies, and compute a sell price after applying a per-currency percentage buy markup entered on the settings form. Three content routes render the stored rates: an exchange-rates page, a Buy 100 page, and a JSON endpoint. The project's distinguishing intent is customer-facing FX markup tables for financial, e-commerce, and multi-currency sites, but the shipped 1.10.x code is early and partial: several service methods are stubs, the settings-installed config object name does not match the object the code reads, a Currency Rates block references a service and client class that are not present in the module, and the page controller unconditionally calls the Drupal Commerce current-store service, so the content routes require Commerce even though it is not a declared dependency.
